title: AI infrastructure — sellers of the power bottleneck
thesis: Hyperscaler capex for 2026 is ~$700B and rising while chip supply is sold out through 2027, so the binding constraint on the buildout has moved from compute to electricity: turbines, switchgear, grid construction and firm power. Whoever owns gas-turbine, electrical-equipment, grid-build and nuclear/IPP capacity is paid by every data center regardless of which chip or model wins, and that capacity cannot be expanded in under 24-36 months. Hold the sellers of electrons, not the users.

invalidation.rule: Basket drawdown >= 30% from its running peak (mechanical), OR two consecutive quarters in which at least two of MSFT/GOOGL/AMZN/META cut forward capex guidance (manual check at each scoring run).
invalidation.manual_check: Did >=2 of MSFT/GOOGL/AMZN/META cut forward capex guidance in each of the last two quarters?

sizing.note: entry_prices are reference closes of 2026-10-09 recorded at seal; actual fills are reconciled from the account. Fund with settled cash only (THS-001B lesson).
